blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Deputy Speaker and Iloilo Rep. Janette Garin on Saturday said that the House of Representatives is ready to address and discuss concerns raised by budget watchdogs on the General Appropriations Bill (GAB) for fiscal year 2027. Garin made the response as the proposed P7.2-trillion 2027 national budget is under Senate review.
